correctness.rationale: A partition with a distinguished block of size \(r\) is in bijection with an \(r\)-subset and a partition of the complement; \(K_n\) becomes exactly \(1+K_{n-r}\). This proves the Palm identity and covariance formula. Bell numbers are moments of a nondegenerate Poisson variable and are therefore strictly log-convex, so consecutive Bell ratios strictly increase and the covariance bracket has one sign switch. The standard Bell-ratio asymptotic and explicit differentiation locate the threshold at \(\alpha_n+1\).

value.rationale: Total block count and fixed-size block multiplicities are canonical random-partition observables. The exact size-biased law explains their dependence structurally and reveals a natural positive-to-negative covariance transition at the logarithmic Lambert-W block-size scale. This phase information is not supplied by separate marginal asymptotics.
